/mob/NPC/Gravity_Training_Enthusiast.talk: warrior Gravity Training Enthusiast This is the gravity training buildingEach of the four chambers has a different level of gravity. To turn on a gravity machine, a new tab will open up when close enoughWhile gravity is on, you will lose a percent of your Powerlevel each pull, how much depends on which room.You must self train or focus train while gravity training to gain increased exp,tp, and stat ticks how much of an increase depends on the room.The first room is 100x gravity, then 200x, 300x, and 500x. In the 100x room, your stat ticks are increased about 5%, while in the 500x room, they're increased about 25%, however the higher the gravity, the more health you will lose each pull
